SQL:
WITH input_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_input_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_confirm_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as unique_sessions
FROM input_visits i
JOIN confirm_visits c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.first_input_stamp < c.first_confirm_stamp
